list: **Web Development**: fast, responsive apps with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js
**Mobile Development**: cross-platform iOS and Android apps with React Native and Expo
**AI/LLM Integration**: chatbots, agentic workflows and RAG with OpenAI, Claude and MCP

list: AI chatbots and assistants, agentic workflows and personalized AI features
